biography:
== Biography ==
Eliza was born in Ireland about 1836-1840. She married Jeremiah O'Donnell, a tailor, and in 1861 they lived in the City of London with their son James W.<ref name="cen1861">"1861 England Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/8767/records/5480522 : accessed 18 November 2026), St Benet, City of London, ED 9, schedule 52; TNA RG 9/227, folio 76, p. 9. Jeremiah O'Donnell (indexed "Samuel"), head, 26, tailor, born Ireland; Eliza, wife, 25, born Ireland; James W., son, 1, born St Benet, London.</ref> By 1870 they were in Cambridge, Massachusetts.<ref name="cen1870">"1870 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/7163/records/26847081 : accessed 18 November 2026), Cambridge Ward 4, Middlesex, Massachusetts, dwelling 82; NARA M593 roll 624, p. 591A. Jeremiah O'Donnell 35, Eliza 28, James W. 10 (born England), Michael J. 8 (born England), Jerome J. 2.</ref> She was named as Elizabeth, mother of James W. O'Donnell, at his 1882 marriage.<ref name="marr1882">"Massachusetts, State Vital Records, 1638-1927", database with images, FamilySearch (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:NW5J-1BC : accessed 18 November 2026), James W. O'Donnell and Susan T. Mullen, married 21 Sep 1882, Boston, entry 2849. Groom 23, brass finisher, born England, parents Jerome and Elizabeth; bride 21, born Cambridge, parents James and Catharine.</ref>

An Eliza O'Donnell, married, aged 36, born in Ireland, the daughter of James O'Hea and Ann, died in Cambridge on 7 May 1876.<ref name="elizadeath">"Massachusetts, U.S., Death Records, 1841-1915", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/2101/records/6009299 : accessed 18 November 2026), Eliza O'Donnell, died 7 May 1876, Cambridge, entry 404; married, 36 years 6 months; born Ireland; parents James O'Hea and Ann.</ref> Jeremiah was a widower by 1880.<ref name="cen1880">"1880 United States Federal Census", database with images, Ancestry (https://www.ancestry.com/search/collections/6742/records/15361280 : accessed 18 November 2026), 8 Davis St, Cambridge, Middlesex, Massachusetts, ED 431, p. 309A. Jeremiah O'Donnell, 45, widower, tailor, born Ireland; children James 19, Michael 18, Joseph 12, Julia 9, Francis 7, Lizzie 5.</ref>

=== Research Notes ===
* Her maiden name O'Hea and her 1876 death are probable but not proven: the death record does not name her husband.
